content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NFSU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https:/ / www.nfsu.ac.in/ career. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NFSU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form for Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts at NFSU is 30 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts in various disciplines like General Chemistry, General Physics, and Cyber Security & Digital Forensics.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NFSU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NFSU Assistant Professor (Contractual) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Assistant Professor posts at NFSU?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts is 50 years. Age relaxation for reserved categories will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Assistant Professor (Contractual) at NFSU?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) positions at NFSU will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 75000 to Rs. 90000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the application fees for NFSU Assistant Professor Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 250 for SC/ST/Women candidates. This fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NFSU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for Assistant Professor (Contractual) positions at NFSU includes a Screening Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must qualify both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for NFSU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The job location for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts is Agartala, Tripura, with pincode 799001.

faq.question: Q9. What is the required qualification for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master's degree with at least 60% marks and a Ph.D. in the concerned/relevant/allied subject, along with a minimum of two publications in UGC-CARE listed journals.

faq.question: Q10. How can I download the official notification for NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF from the career section of the National Forensic Sciences University's official website, nfsu.ac.in/career.
